subject: Bezalel Smotrich
topic: Freeze of NIS 200m grant for Arab local authorities
resolution_notes: Smotrich rejected/held a NIS 200m transfer earmarked for Arab local authorities despite Interior Minister Moshe Arbel warning that withholding it could push municipalities into financial difficulty. Smotrich publicly defended the freeze as necessary until safeguards could prevent funds reaching criminal or terrorist elements. Arab local authorities later struck over the withheld funds; an oversight-based release was subsequently agreed and the Knesset Finance Committee later approved the NIS 200m transfer under Government Decision 550. No court, State Comptroller, inquiry or equivalent finding establishing a concrete personal governance failure or wrongdoing by Smotrich has been recovered, so do not canonicalize this as an adverse accountability event yet.
media_status: Non-social reporting and later official Knesset record recovered; exact ministerial letter/original statement media not yet attached, so no media card or substitute preview.
